design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER - task 1 (appointment_booking_and_missed_visits, category series)

0. Draw and scope. draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 4, 6, 6]}. Tree: root series_ext_package_portal_booking (4 factors), prerequisites series_ext_first_visit_no_show_fee (4), series_ext_late_arrival_fee (6), series_ext_same_day_cancellation_fee (6). Occupied by task 0: series_ext_late_cancellation_fee, series_ext_no_show_fee, series_ext_insured_portal_booking and their tools. Claimed here: the four policies above and tools assess_first_visit_no_show_fee_a4cbc15c, assess_late_arrival_fee_e6f6ddb6, assess_same_day_cancellation_fee_8648d00e, book_package_portal_visits_336412d0 (owner=user). Disjointness: task 0's no-show policy excludes the series' first appointment (this task's first-appointment policy covers it); task 0's late-cancellation policy is for cancellations before the appointment day, this task's same-day policy for cancellations on the day and its late-arrival policy for zero-notice arrivals beyond grace; task 0 books on an insurance-funded series, this task on a package-funded series (package cover, surgery phase, clearance limits instead of authorization, series age and attendance). After this task every extended policy is claimed; nothing is reserved.
Base defect routed around (blueprint frozen): the difficulty summary says no write here is the patient's own; the patient's self-scheduling in the portal (portal_booking_allowed true for Post-Operative Priority) is used as the owner=user problem.

1. Why this is a good test. The patient asks only to self-book more rehab sessions. The opened count shortens with the missed-visit fees on the series, and three misses of three different kinds sit unassessed inside their fee assessment period. The agent must classify each (first-appointment no-show; a zero-notice entry with minutes late = late arrival under the format's late_cancellation treatment; a same-day voicemail cancellation), charge them in the pinned order (the late-arrival and same-day fees each wait on the earlier fee entries through their repeat shares), compute three fees that read the funding package's cash rate, the patient's forfeits on another package and her hardship determination, and only then compute the booking count from the package (payment status, visits covered, expiry runway) and the clearance date.

2. Problem-tree card.
  - series_ext_package_portal_booking -> series_ext_first_visit_no_show_fee (value_input, state): "The number of appointments a package portal booking opens is fixed only after a no-show on the series' first appointment within its fee assessment period carries its first-appointment no-show fee entry."
  - series_ext_package_portal_booking -> series_ext_late_arrival_fee (value_input, state): "A package portal booking is not opened until every late arrival beyond the grace period recorded on the series within its fee assessment period shows a late-arrival fee entry."
  - series_ext_package_portal_booking -> series_ext_same_day_cancellation_fee (value_input, state): "The package portal booking count is fixed only after every same-day cancellation recorded on the series within its fee assessment period carries its same-day cancellation fee entry."
  - series_ext_late_arrival_fee -> series_ext_first_visit_no_show_fee (value_input, state): "The late-arrival fee is fixed only after a no-show recorded on the series' first appointment within its fee assessment period carries its first-appointment no-show fee entry."
  - series_ext_same_day_cancellation_fee -> series_ext_first_visit_no_show_fee (value_input, state): "A same-day cancellation fee is not charged until every no-show on the series' first appointment recorded within its fee assessment period shows a first-appointment no-show fee entry."
  - series_ext_same_day_cancellation_fee -> series_ext_late_arrival_fee (value_input, state): "The same-day cancellation fee is fixed only after every late arrival beyond the grace period recorded on the series within its fee assessment period carries its late-arrival fee entry."
  Four-point test: each sentence carries 'only after' or 'not ... until', waits on a record-visible state (a fee entry standing against a specific kind of miss inside its fee assessment period), names no tool, id or code token, and covers exactly one miss kind. Directions are mixed (fixed-figure sentences affirmative, the booking release and the charge of the same-day fee negated). State-form uniqueness: a fee entry against a first-appointment no-show is written only by the first-appointment policy (task 0's no-show policy excludes first appointments), against a zero-notice late-arrival entry only by the late-arrival policy, against a same-day cancellation only by the same-day policy. Derivation: sentences + history (20089c46-41ed-4ec0-8009-70d9c598cbd4, b82535e1-3bc1-4929-9a7c-cd4173418fc1, 121822c3-da79-49fa-8d60-c694f7c24df0 with no series_fee_assessed pointing at them; missed_fee_balance 0.00) + the fee policies' own scope sentences -> the three fee writes in topological order.
  Opening falsity: series_events.20089c46-41ed-4ec0-8009-70d9c598cbd4 (no-show on 2026-02-28 = series_start_date), b82535e1-3bc1-4929-9a7c-cd4173418fc1 (notice 0, minutes_late 21), 121822c3-da79-49fa-8d60-c694f7c24df0 (notice 1, received 2026-03-03), no fee entries, balance 0.00.
  Order: first-appointment fee (step 9) -> late-arrival fee (11) -> same-day fee (13) -> booking (15); every pair is edge-ordered, so unique.
  Deletion sensitivity: skip first-appointment fee -> late-arrival 14.65 (gold 18.31), same-day 46.88 (gold 56.25), booking 12 (gold 9); skip late-arrival -> same-day 46.88, booking 12; skip same-day -> booking 12. All six edges value_input and load-bearing.
  user_scenario withholds the misses; tools validate nothing (prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block). The owner=user problem is the root booking, done by the patient in her own portal on the spot.

3. Factor card.
  First-appointment fee 19.53 (baseline 50.0): basis 62.50 = 50% of cash rate 125.00 [35a59375-4bec-485c-9389-8126d107b76a] (15.62); lead 2 days -> 50 [ca3401ab-f288-46c3-a638-16459e0fad48] (39.06); forfeits 1 -> 125, near-miss: the 2026-01-14 grace no-show left no forfeit (15.62); hardship Level 2 -> 50 [541506a4-b3f9-4f2c-8dff-e4b6a2ab7156] (39.06).
  Late-arrival fee 18.31 (baseline 35.0): basis 62.50 (10.25); 21 minutes -> 50, near-miss: limit 25 (36.62); repeat 125 from step 9 (14.65); forfeits 125 (14.65); hardship 50 (36.62); new series 3 days -> 75 (24.41).
  Same-day fee 56.25 (baseline 35.0): basis 62.50 (31.5); notice 1 h -> 120 (46.88); repeat 150 from steps 9 and 11 (37.5); forfeits 125 (45.0); hardship 50 (112.5); reason transportation -> 80 (70.31).
  Package portal booking 9 (baseline 4): window 28 days from 3 fees (15); cover limit 15 on the paid-in-full tier (4); clearance limit 18 (4); expiry limit 18, package expires in 229 days (4).
  Multi-source: package_portal_cover_limit (amount paid AND price on the package AND the installment payments in its history against its due dates), the fee bases (series funding AND package tier rate) and the three hardship shares. Cross-difficulty: package (bases, forfeit shares, cover), hardship; all rows seeded. Overrides declared on series_evt_missed_visit_fees (fee schedule sentence) and series_booking_eligibility (batch/horizon sentence); all other base rules inherited.

4. Base-invariant card. fee_assessed_in_time: anchor = appointment_date, day zero, 3 days, not_after, inclusive: 2026-02-28 -> day 3 at 2026-03-03 (boundary, passes); 2026-03-02 -> day 1; 2026-03-03 -> day 0. Package funding: Post-Surgical 18 has missed_visit_forfeits_visit false, so the series fee rules apply (base sentence inherited). fee_on_first_appointment true for Post-Operative. Monthly cap 2: February has 1 fee (2026-02-28), March 2 (2026-03-02, 2026-03-03) - none beyond the cap. Release: post-operative late cancellations do not count; no-shows across series in 60 days = 2 (2026-01-14 prehab, 2026-02-28) < 3, no release obligation. Booking gates: status booked (allowed), no fee past due (new fees due in 30 days), restriction none, the only plan of care is discharged with balance 0.00; no combined weekly cap for a package.

5. Business-object card. Fee objects: 20089c46-41ed-4ec0-8009-70d9c598cbd4, b82535e1-3bc1-4929-9a7c-cd4173418fc1, 121822c3-da79-49fa-8d60-c694f7c24df0, each charged once with source_event_id; the prehab series' no-show and late cancellation are excluded (package forfeit/grace, different series, outside the assessment period). Booking object: series 1fabe434-f2c2-404b-a619-a59843a7d4dc; 3 appointments still booked (2026-03-07, 03-09, 03-10) are subtracted.

6. Seed rows. Customer; post-op series and its 4 entries (fee objects, booking lead time); prehab series and its 7 entries plus the Recovery package and its 7 entries (the forfeit evidence and the grace-miss near-miss, consistent with forfeit_grace_per_package 1: redeemed 4 + forfeited 1 = 5 of 6, 1 left); Post-Surgical package with payment and 18-visit credit (cash rate, cover, status); hardship case (hardship shares); discharged plan of care (booking block evidence). No row ignites another difficulty's obligation (packages active and paid, hardship approved, plan discharged with zero balance). No cache trap.

7. Persona. Warm, tired post-op patient paying cash; volunteers only the goal, the portal preference and the start date; identity on request (phone, DOB, ZIP); the three misses only as a reaction; no dispute, no waiver ask, payment deferred to the statement; books exactly what she is told; ends after the confirmation.

8. Standard solution. Locate -> verify -> series -> post-op history -> packages -> package history -> hardship -> plans of care -> first-appointment fee 19.53 on 20089c46-41ed-4ec0-8009-70d9c598cbd4 -> late-arrival fee 18.31 (late_cancellation) on b82535e1-3bc1-4929-9a7c-cd4173418fc1 -> same-day fee 56.25 on 121822c3-da79-49fa-8d60-c694f7c24df0 -> hand over: series 1fabe434-f2c2-404b-a619-a59843a7d4dc, start 2026-03-14, 9 visits.

9. Verification. a temporary authoring script (it imported check_compute.build_env / eval_compute / substitute and the real share and task tools; removed from the write domain after the run) replays the gold with the real tools and evaluates each compute on the handling-time world exactly as check_compute does; the numbers above are its output. Per-task gates run and recorded in the final report.

10. Closure. FV -> assess_first_visit_no_show_fee_a4cbc15c -> step 9 amount; LA -> assess_late_arrival_fee_e6f6ddb6 -> step 11 amount; SD -> assess_same_day_cancellation_fee_8648d00e -> step 13 amount; BK -> book_package_portal_visits_336412d0 -> step 15 visits. One frozen_time, no waits.

11. Draft recomputation from visible context gives the same writes; the only choices (which entry each fee is for, the fee kind of the late arrival, the start date) are each pinned by one record, one tier parameter or one customer line.

12. Pitfalls: treating the zero-notice entry as a same-day cancellation; charging the late arrival as a no-show; counting the 2026-01-14 grace miss as a forfeit; using the schedule fee instead of the cash basis; charging out of order; booking before the fees; ignoring the 3 still-booked appointments; stopping at the standard batch of 4 by missing the package's paid-in-full status, its expiry runway or the surgical protocol date.

13. Gate run (final, difficulty-wide): EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK; SOLVABILITY OK; COMPUTE OK (suite means branches 62.50, steps 15.00; history_rows_max 32; branches_max 70); GROUNDING OK; CACHE-DIFF INFO; SCOPE OK. check_traceability is deferred until the KB is published.
14. Rework round 2 (policy-task audit findings; symptom -> root cause -> change -> re-run).
  T1-1 / F-2 (RED): the package portal weekly-count ladder (surgery phase -> format min / format max / standing) could only ever divide Post-Operative series, whose standing count is itself 2 or 3, so its fall-through always duplicated a tier. The factor is removed; the window appointments now use the series' standing appointments per week (the baseline method). In its place the package portal payment limit (parameter, cross-difficulty package): the format batch where the amount paid has reached the purchase price, bp_part_paid_batch (6) where the package is part paid, the standard batch 4 where nothing is paid - three distinct values on every format. This world: paid in full 1764.00 -> 18. The count moves from 5 to 9 (4 weeks x 3 - 3 booked); baseline 4; per-factor baselines window 15, cover 4, clearance 4, payment 4; skipping any fee gives 12.
  T1-2 / F-1 (RED): the late-arrival lateness ladder mixed a 'grace + 10 minutes' bound with a 'half the slot' bound, leaving an empty middle tier and overlapping outer tiers on Standard, Post-Operative and Telehealth. The ladder is now measured only in minutes beyond the grace period: up to la_near_grace_minutes (10) -> 50, more than 10 up to la_far_grace_minutes (20) -> la_mid_grace_pct 75, more than 20 -> 100; disjoint and non-empty on every format. This world: 21 minutes = 6 beyond grace -> 50, fee unchanged 18.31.
  O-1: the late-arrival fee now applies only on formats whose late_arrival_beyond_grace_treated_as is late_cancellation; on a no_show format the late arrival is a no-show charged as one. The tool no longer takes a fee_kind argument (always late_cancellation), so step 11 passes series_id, source_event_id and amount only.
  O-2 / O-4: the same-day fee is charged only for a cancellation by the patient, not the clinic, and is worked out on the most recent cancellation that carries no minutes late (so a late-arrival entry is never its anchor); the booking's same-day condition now matches that scope (patient cancellation on the appointment day, no minutes late), which also covers a sub-hour same-day cancellation.
  O-6: the cover-limit draw tier now names only Extended 60-Minute Visit Series (Specialty cannot be portal-booked).
  Ladder hygiene: hardship tier 2 requires a discount above zero; package portal clearance mid batch is 6 so no format's tiers coincide.
  T1-O1 (cash-rate clause never divides package customers) is left: the funding-source half decides the basis tier and the clause guards a tier without a cash rate.
  Persona: the line about fewer appointments per week was removed, since no factor now reduces the weekly count.
  Re-run: FV 19.53, LA 18.31, SD 56.25, booking 9; full gate block green.
15. Rework round 3 (policy-task audit revision 2).
  T1-3 / F-3 (RED): the package portal cover limit's fall-through (a non-active package) and the payment limit's fall-through (nothing paid) could never apply to a lawful package booking - base series_booking_eligibility requires an active funding package and a package is activated by its first payment. Both ladders are replaced by ladders whose every tier is reachable by a customer with an active, partly or fully paid package:
    package portal cover limit (method): paid in full -> the package's covered appointments ((visits remaining - draw x booked) // draw, draw = extended_visit_draw on Extended 60-Minute, 1 otherwise); paid in installments, not fully paid and every installment more than installment_late_days past due paid -> covered appointments capped at one installment's credit (visits_included // installment_count); an overdue installment unpaid (package still active, crediting stopped by the package charter) -> standard batch 4. This world: paid in full -> 15.
    package portal expiry limit (parameter, replaces the payment limit): expiry more than 90 days after the booking date -> format batch; 31-90 days -> 6; 30 days or fewer (package still active) -> 4. This world: 229 days -> 18.
  PB now has 4 factors with every tier lawful: window (p), cover limit (m), clearance limit (p), expiry limit (p). Count unchanged at 9; baselines window 15, cover 4, clearance 4, expiry 4; all-baseline 4; skipping any fee gives 12.
  O-7: the late-arrival sentences of the same-day fee and the package booking now read 'every late arrival beyond the grace period recorded on the series as a zero-notice cancellation', equal to their conditions.
  O-8: the late-arrival baseline and schedule-fee binding no longer carry the unreachable no_show branch; both are late_cancel_fee.
  O-2 residual (before-day vs later same-day cancellation on one series): left latent; the compute primitives can filter only by equal values, so the anchor cannot select 'received before / on the appointment day' per entry; not reached on this world (one same-day cancellation, no before-day cancellation in the window).
  Re-run: FV 19.53, LA 18.31, SD 56.25, booking 9 - unchanged; full gate block green.
user_scenario: You are Lorraine Hutchins, 58, a part-time library assistant in Huntersville who had your right knee replaced on Thursday, February 26. You are a little tired and sore, chatty in a warm way, and you apologize for rambling. You are paying for your rehab yourself with a post-surgical visit package, and your physical therapy is at the Huntersville clinic with Priya Natarajan on Monday, Tuesday and Saturday mornings at 8:00. You call because you want to get the rest of your rehab appointments on the calendar past the ones you already have; your daughter set up the patient portal for you and you would like to do the booking there yourself while you are on the phone, but you are unsure how many appointments you are allowed to put in, so you want the representative to tell you. You want the new appointments to begin on Saturday, March 14, at your usual 8:00 time, because your next three appointments are already set for March 7, 9 and 10. When asked how to find you, you give your cell number, 7045553917. To prove who you are you give your date of birth, 1967-09-30 (September 30, 1967); if they want something more, you give your ZIP code, 28078. If asked which appointments you mean, it is your knee rehab series at Huntersville; your earlier pre-surgery sessions on Wednesdays are finished and you don't want to touch them. You know this first week has gone badly: your ride never came on Saturday the 28th so you missed your very first session, on Monday you got there about twenty minutes late and they couldn't see you, and early this morning you left a voicemail cancelling today's session because your daughter's car wouldn't start. You do not mention any of this unless the representative brings it up. If they tell you there are charges to post for those visits, or that something has to be taken care of first, you sigh, say you understand and that they should go ahead with whatever they need to do; you don't argue about the amounts and you don't ask for anything to be dropped, and if they offer to take a payment you say you'll pay once you see it on your statement. If they say the portal will only take a certain number of appointments for now, you accept that. If they offer to book them for you, you say you'd really like to do it yourself in the portal so you learn how. When the representative tells you your series reference number and how many appointments to book, you enter them in the portal yourself using exactly that series reference, the start date of March 14, 2026 and that number, and you read back the confirmation it shows. Once the appointments are booked you thank them warmly, say you'll be there on the 7th, and say goodbye.
